The Mayor's Office of Contract Services (MOCS) is a New York City oversight and service agency that manages procurement citywide, from planning and release of agency solicitations to payment of vendors. Annually, agencies procure billions in products and services from a diverse pool of vendors that represent various industries. MOCS therefore aims to ensure that the procurement process remains fair, transparent, efficient and cost-effective. MOCS makes it easier to do business through use of end-to-end technology tools, increases transparency by publication of enriched data and hosting public hearings, and strengthens procurement operations by providing direct assistance and resources to all stakeholders. MOCS also partners with agencies and vendors to identify areas for policy reform, resulting in ongoing process improvement to reduce administrative burdens and increase the positive impact of services on communities. The MOCS Director serves as the City Chief Procurement Officer. JOB DESCRIPTION: ANALYST MOCS team members operate in a fast-paced, collaborative, service-oriented environment, where flexibility and ability to achieve results are valued. Analysts perform a range of defined tasks assigned by supervisors. All MOCS analysts are expected to deliver timely and quality work products and services, participate in ongoing improvement activities, proactively deepen their knowledge of procurement and government operations, and will use modern technology software and hardware to complete daily duties. Analysts also collaborate with other team members to implement projects, help to maintain and/or analyze operational data, and interact with external stakeholders. ASSIGNMENT AND CURRENT RESPONSIBILITIES The Service Desk Unit is part of a central services and support group within the Technology Division at MOCS. The team is both responsible for ensuring that all MOCS stakeholders have access to the most current information and driving best practices related to sustainable knowledge acquisition and skills building. The Service Desk operates as a central service and support team, responding to incoming inquiries, screenings, and onboarding of vendors to technology platforms. Staff aim to provide clear, accurate and timely information to stakeholders, coordinating responses across various operational and technical teams, and documenting and partnering to resolve any issues which inhibit task completion or the overall success of critical city initiatives. Responsibilities including, but not limited to: - Review, analyze and verify information associated with vendor accounts and various filings; - Communicate with stakeholders using various platforms including our internal ticketing system, email, phone and screensharing; - Troubleshoot issues by utilizing materials, research, creative thinking and problem-solving skills; - Using exceptional writing skills and communication, research and convey helpful information to stakeholders and vendors who need support and assistance; - Determine when issues should be referred to peers or other units and/or escalated to managers; - Record user interaction and categorical data in designated customer services platforms, e.g. JIRA; - Propose updates to user resources for systems such as PASSPort and HHS Accelerator; - Take part in ongoing professional development to strengthen skills and increase knowledge in relevant areas of procurement, technology, government operations, public policy and people and change management; - Understand issues affecting relevant stakeholder groups, including but not limited to city agencies/partners, Minority and Women-owned Business Enterprises (M/WBEs), nonprofits, etc.; - Participate in special projects, as assigned. PREFERRED SKILLS Demonstrate competency and/or history of consistent quality performance in the following areas of responsibility: - Strong writing skills are required - Succinctly and effectively communicate verbally and in writing - Meet deadlines and work independently while paying close attention to details - Exceptional time management skills to deliver consistent results in a fast-paced environment - Establish relationships quickly and maximize positive team dynamics - Distill complex material, present/share information and make actionable recommendations - Accurately and consistently document data on stakeholder experience and escalate critical issues - Analyze data and summarize research to support ongoing improvement in operations and service - Educate stakeholders about various procurement and government operations topics and tools and - Engage and support stakeholders through all phases of procurement and change. TO APPLY External applicants, please go to www.nyc.gov/careers/search and search for Job ID #768503 Current City Employees may apply via Employee Self Service (ESS) http://cityshare.nycnet/ess Click on Recruiting Activities/Careers and Search for Job ID #768503 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION To best serve the City we represent, Mayor’s Office of Contract Services (MOCS) seeks individuals from a variety of backgrounds who can bring different perspectives to contribute to the work of the office. MOCS also seeks candidates who want to contribute to a work environment that values teamwork, inclusion and respect. MOCS recognizes the unique skills and strengths gained through military service. Veterans and service members of the U.S. Armed Forces are strongly encouraged to apply. Special accommodations provided to applicants with disabilities. description:
Established in 2004,
OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of
The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our
AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)

Language requirement:

fluency in German or Spanish

Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.

Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.

Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.

Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.

Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.

Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.

Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.

Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.

Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.

Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.

Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.

Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.

Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:

Essential

10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.

A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).

Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).

A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.

Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.

Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.

Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.

Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.

Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.

Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.

Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like:

Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.

Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.

Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.

Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

description: Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. The Center for Health Equity & Community Wellness (CHECW) seeks to eliminate racial and other inequities resulting in premature mortality. We are seeking a visionary leader to serve as Deputy Commissioner/Chief Equity Officer, driving transformative change to create healthier, more equitable communities across New York City. About CHECW: CHECW is at the forefront of addressing the root causes of health inequities. With a focus on social, environmental, and commercial determinants of health, we work to dismantle centuries of systemic injustice and build a future where every New Yorker has the opportunity to thrive. Our work spans community and healthcare systems, partnering with community and faith-based groups, health delivery organizations, and city agencies to tackle inequities head-on. CHECW is home to seven bureaus, including Bronx, Brooklyn, and Harlem Neighborhood Health, Chronic Disease Prevention, Finance and Administrative Services, and Equitable Health Systems. CHECW also houses the newly formed Queens Neighborhood Health bureau. Together, we address both upstream and downstream factors to improve health outcomes for all. The Office of the Chief Equity Officer, housed within CHECW, provides executive leadership to advance equity internally across the agency, with a particular focus on embedding systemic equity principles into programs, and operations. The office advances the Race to Justice initiative by driving organizational accountability, informing strategic decision-making, and supporting the implementation of equitable practices across all levels of the department. The Opportunity: As Deputy Commissioner/Chief Equity Officer, you will lead a dynamic division of over 500 employees with an annual budget of $85M and $70M in grant funding. Reporting directly to the Commissioner of Health, you will set the strategic vision for advancing health equity, investing in place-based programming, embedding anti-racist practices, and driving systemic change across the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH). The Deputy Commissioner will oversee the "Race to Justice" initiative, a transformative effort to dismantle institutional racism within DOHMH and beyond. You will work with diverse teams, community partners, and city leaders to create policies and programs that deliver measurable, equitable outcomes for all New Yorkers. What You’ll Do: Lead with Vision: Shape and execute a bold strategy to transform DOHMH into an anti-racist organization, embedding equity into every aspect of operations, policies, and programs. Drive Change: Oversee the Race to Justice initiative, building capacity across the agency to understand and address systemic racism while fostering a culture of accountability and measurable progress. Build Partnerships: Strengthen relationships with community organizations, faith-based groups, and city agencies to advance place-based health equity initiatives and improve coordination of services. Innovate for Impact: Develop and implement cutting-edge public health policies and practices that address the root causes of health inequities and improve outcomes for NYC’s most impacted communities. Inspire and Empower: Lead a team of Assistant Commissioners and equity champions, fostering collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to justice and equity. Champion Equity: Represent CHECW at high-level meetings with City Hall, elected officials, and community stakeholders, advocating for policies and investments that prioritize health equity. What We’re Looking For: We are seeking a bold, innovative leader with a deep commitment to racial justice and health equity. The ideal candidate will bring: Education and Management Experience Requirements: Minimum of a Masters from an accredited college or university with major coursework in public policy, sociology, education, ethnic studies, public relations, social work, public health, public administration or a related field; A minimum of 5-7 years of managerial experience especially within governmental or nonprofit sectors. A minimum of 5-7 years of progressive responsibility in policy advocacy and/or community organizing in areas at the intersection of racial justice and health Leadership & Vision: Demonstrated success in leading large teams and driving organizational change. A strategic mindset with the ability to translate vision into action and measurable results. Equity Expertise: A deep understanding of systemic racism and its impact on health outcomes. Experience applying a racial equity lens to decision-making, program design, and policy development. Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and partnerships across diverse stakeholders. A collaborative approach to leadership, fostering teamwork and shared accountability. Innovation & Impact: A creative thinker with a track record of developing and implementing innovative public health initiatives. A results-driven leader who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Why Join Us? This is your chance to lead transformative work that will shape the future of public health in NYC. As Deputy Commissioner/Chief Equity Officer, you’ll have the opportunity to: Drive systemic change and make a measurable impact on health equity. Collaborate with passionate, mission-driven colleagues and community partners. Lead innovative initiatives that address the root causes of health inequities. Be part of a team that is reimagining what’s possible for public health in NYC. Ready to Make a Difference? Join us in building a healthier, more equitable future for all New Yorkers. Apply today to become the Deputy Commissioner/Chief Equity Officer at CHECW. Why you should work for us? Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/) - Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as: o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment. o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund. o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement. o a tax-deferred savings program and o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers. Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home. - Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work. Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers! The NYC Health Department is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation to all individuals. To request reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact Sye-Eun Ahn, Director of the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity, at sahn1@health.nyc.gov or 347-396-6549.

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The Exploit Intelligence Company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Rapid Response organization - regionally-based teams in the US, UK, and APAC that keep our customers unblocked around the clock. You’ll manage engineering teams of senior ICs directly, set the technical and operational bar for the group, and make sure work is prioritised correctly across a demanding mix of urgent and long-term needs.

This team sits at the intersection of Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales. Your teams handle urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, and other customer-driven feature requests, alongside the backend maintenance and integration work that keeps the platform stable. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting engineering standards, coaching engineers, and triaging competing priorities across time zones.
This is a 100% remote role, with preference for candidates located in Cheltenham, UK

Manage and grow engineering teams based in the US, UK, and APAC, providing hands-on people leadership, coaching, and career development

Set priorities across urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, customer feature requests, and backend maintenance/integration work, balancing reactive and proactive work

Ensure continuous, follow-the-sun coverage for urgent customer and pre-sales needs across time zones

Partner closely with Customer Success and Sales leadership to understand customer and deal-critical needs and translate them into engineering plans

Partner with Product and other Engineering teams to ensure customer-driven work is integrated into the broader platform roadmap

Own the team's engineering quality bar, including code quality, root-cause practices, and long-term fixes over one-off patches

Drive hiring, onboarding, and performance management across all three regional teams

Establish and refine on-call, escalation, and incident response processes for the team

Report on team health, throughput, and customer outcomes to engineering and company leadership

Remove blockers for your teams and stay close enough to the technical work to make credible calls under pressure

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience managing software engineers, ideally across distributed or multi-region teams

Experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or threat intelligence

Prior experience as a senior or staff software engineer, with credibility to engage in technical discussions and unblock your team

Experience managing customer-facing, support, sustaining, or reliability engineering teams

Proven ability to prioritize and sequence competing demands—urgent customer issues, pre-sales asks, and longer-term maintenance work

Experience managing teams across multiple time zones and regions, with strong async communication habits

Solid understanding of backend systems, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)

A customer-obsessed mindset and a track record of turning technical challenges into strong customer outcomes

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, Sales, Customer Success, and other Engineering teams

Experience working with data pipelines, ETL systems, or high-volume data processing is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience managing a customer reliability, sustaining, support, or escalation engineering function

Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets

Experience supporting pre-sales or deal-critical technical requests

Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

Generous, flexible time off

Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)

Comprehensive healthcare coverage

Generous paid parental leave

Remote-friendly environment with flexibility

Support for home office costs (phone & internet)

Ongoing professional development, coaching, and learning resources

Opportunities for career advancement within a fast-growing team

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

As a Business Development Representative, you'll help drive our growth by building our outbound sales engine and creating new customer opportunities.
Cold calling is how we won our first customers, and it's still our strongest channel.

This role is a fast track into sales.
Outbound experience? You'll move to (Junior) AE in 3-6 months.

are motivated to build from the ground up and enjoy working hands-on
have excellent communication skills in English (one additional European language is a big plus)
enjoy talking to prospects, understanding their needs, and convincing them
enjoy working with targets
treat your pipeline like a product – always testing, always improving

Ambitious teammates who see their work as more than just a job
Munich is our hub. In-person by design, we support your relocation within Europe

Zeit AI package: daily lunch allowance, covered dinner in the office, wellpass membership, best tech & tools

job_title: Chief of Staff to the Co-CEO - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.
Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.
About the Role
Judith Dada is Co-CEO of Langdock alongside Lennard. She is also Senior Partner at Visionaries Club, serves on the board of Personio, co-founded Relativity Collective, a programme for Europe’s student founders, and writes about AI, creativity, Europe and human flourishing as Dadalogue. She co-authored
Europa 2031
. What connects all of it is a conviction that technological progress, done well, is how we build a better Europe and a better world.
As Chief of Staff, you will be Judith’s right hand across everything she does. Your job is to extend her reach and impact across Langdock, Europe’s AI ecosystem and beyond. You will structure and execute across a wide surface area, and create the conditions in which Judith does her best work. You will work with her every day, so expect the steepest learning curve of your career.
Langdock’s product is expanding fast in two directions: across the work people do, with chat, agents, meetings, code and apps; and down the stack into our own compute and inference. You will help Judith stay close to the most important work across this growing product surface and the company.
What You Will Do
Run meticulous project management.
You will hold the threads across dozens of topics and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You work half a step ahead, spot bottlenecks before they happen and follow through. You act as an honest broker: synthesising and pressure-testing plans to bring them to their full potential.
Augment Judith’s execution at Langdock.
You will keep Judith close to the most important work across a fast-growing product surface. You will prepare her for key decisions, make sure things happen afterwards and support strategic workstreams.
Produce Judith’s ideas.
You will structure and challenge Judith’s thinking to draw out the idea worth making, then shape it into a keynote, essay, video, panel, interview or key event. You will help turn customer insights and research into thought leadership that shapes how European leaders think about AI. AI is already an exceptionally capable research assistant; your value lies in depth, taste and operational structure. You do not ghostwrite. You sharpen the thinking and run the flow from first idea to finished piece.
Scale executive engagement.
Together with Marketing, you will design exceptional rooms and experiences that bring Europe’s key AI decision-makers together. You will work with our go-to-market teams so Judith’s external work serves the needs of a customer base that is growing quickly.
Extend Judith’s reach into policy and the European AI ecosystem.
You will prepare and follow through on policy work and ecosystem initiatives, helping Judith contribute to the conversations shaping AI in Europe.
What Makes This Different
You will work at the forefront of one of the most consequential technological shifts in history. Langdock has grown to around $50M ARR and more than 13,000 customers while remaining profitable and independent of outside investment. You will join at a moment when our product is expanding quickly and Europe needs AI companies built from Europe for the world.
Judith is Co-CEO of Langdock, Senior Partner at Visionaries Club and active across the European AI ecosystem. This role gives you a front-row seat across that breadth of work, with direct responsibility for helping turn ideas and decisions into action.
This is a tour of duty. We ask for a commitment of at least two years, with the explicit prospect of shaping a longer-term role together once we know where you shine. The scope is broad, the feedback loops are short and the learning curve is steep.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have a few years of experience in consulting, investing or a startup that grew quickly. You know how to structure chaos and are still incredibly hungry to learn.
You have a deep fascination with technology and AI, and a real belief that technological progress can build a better world.
You have impeccable taste. You know what good looks like in a sentence, a slide, an event and an argument, and you can act with confidence in Judith’s stead.
You have range and depth. You can switch context many times a day and still go deep when it counts.
You write clearly and speak well in the room, in both German and English.
You bring calm and good judgement. You know what matters and what can wait, read people well, and hold them accountable with kindness.
You see problems and fix them without being asked, and stay persistent until they are done.
You are discreet and trustworthy, because you will see everything.
You have an exceptional work ethic and are comfortable with a highly demanding role that includes some travel.
The Environment
You will sit with Judith in our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all 65 of us work together in person. Judith has a dedicated Executive Assistant for calendar, travel and admin. You will work closely with them and with Lennard’s Chief of Staff on day-to-day matters.
Breakfast, lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.
Next steps
We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to hear from you.

description:
Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Visual Localization
Build and lead the team that makes our autonomous systems know where they are.
About SE3
SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.
We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our localization technology, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.
Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.
About the Role
You will hire and develop engineers, own the localization roadmap, set priorities and deliver a system that works on real sensors, within onboard compute limits and in difficult field conditions.
You will remain closely involved in architecture, core algorithms and debugging, with roughly 20–40% of your time spent coding. Work with senior individual contributors to set technical direction and with robotics software, embedded, hardware and field teams to turn it into a reliable deployed system.
What You’ll Work On
Build the Team:
Hire excellent localization engineers, assess their technical work and help them develop. Give clear feedback, establish ownership and build a team that can solve difficult problems together.
Roadmap and Delivery:
Own the roadmap and delivery of VIO, SLAM, sensor fusion, calibration, mapping and relocalization. Turn mission requirements and observed failures into specific engineering priorities.
Technical Direction:
Guide architecture and core algorithm decisions with the team. Make the tradeoffs between accuracy, robustness, latency, memory and power explicit and test them against real data.
Evaluation and Replay:
Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team can make most improvements from recorded data. Set measurable criteria for accuracy, robustness and runtime, and maintain regression tests that catch failures before deployment.
Hands-On Engineering:
Stay involved in critical algorithms, production code and difficult debugging. Help resolve failures caused by timing, calibration, vibration, motion blur, poor lighting and degraded sensors.
Integration:
Coordinate sensor and compute requirements, interfaces and integration with adjacent teams. Ensure localization outputs and uncertainty estimates work for planning, control and downstream autonomy.
Field Deployment:
Take the system through live sensor testing and field deployment. Use mission logs and observed failures to decide what the team builds next.
Your Profile
You have personally built VIO or SLAM systems and taken substantial parts through deployment. You can explain your implementation, its limitations and measured improvements in accuracy, robustness or runtime.
You have led engineers through difficult technical work. You can point to systems your team delivered, people you helped develop and the decisions you were responsible for. This may be your first formal management role if you can demonstrate that experience.
You can assess an engineer’s technical work, give useful feedback and help them improve. You take an active role in recruiting and selecting the people who join your team.
You have strong foundations in 3D geometry, estimation, optimization and sensor fusion, and enough depth to examine algorithm and architecture decisions in detail.
You write production C++ and use Python for analysis, evaluation and tooling. You are comfortable working with Linux, real sensors, calibration, synchronization and constrained onboard compute. Rust experience is a plus.
You have used replay, evaluation datasets and automated tests to guide development. You can explain how your team measured progress, reproduced failures and decided when a system was ready to deploy.
You have a master’s degree, PhD or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical field.
You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.
Especially Valued Bonus Skills
Experience deploying perception systems on Nvidia Jetson, embedded CPUs/GPUs, writing CUDA kernels, optimizing deep neural networks for edge deployment.
Experience with LWIR thermal cameras (for navigation), rolling shutter effects, visual-inertial calibration, multi-camera rigs, fisheye/wide-angle lenses or monocular depth.
Experience with GNSS-denied navigation in UAV context, terrain-relative navigation, map-based localization and re-localization.
Experience building evaluation datasets, replay systems, perception observability, log tooling, and automated regression pipelines.
Publications or open-source contributions in SLAM, VIO, 3D computer vision, state estimation, or robotics are welcome, but not required.

Perks & Benefits
Real Ownership:
Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme
Work Environment to Excel at:
Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you
AI-boosted workplace:
We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge
31 Paid Days Off:
30 vacation days plus your birthday off
Well-being Access:
Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass
Team Offsites:
We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece
Mentorship:
Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process
Intro Call (15 min):
Let’s get to know each other
Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min)
: We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together
Technical Interview (1 hr):
We dive into the systems you have delivered, your technical decisions, and how you hire, develop engineers and lead delivery
Team Dinner / Lunch
: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system’s 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the city. The responsibility of maintaining these vast networks falls under the Department of Environmental Protection’s Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO). The primary responsibilities of the Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations are the operation, maintenance and protection of the City’s drinking water and wastewater collection (sewer) systems; the protection of adjacent waterways; and the development and protection of the Department’s Capital Water and Sewer Design Program. The Bureau also approves and inspects water and sewer connections performed by licensed plumbers and/or authorized contractors. In addition, the Bureau has overall responsibility for the approval and inspection of all public and private construction projects which could impact on the City’s water or sewer systems. Collection Systems Investigation's role in the Bureau is to manage investigation projects for the inspection, design, and expansion of the City’s sewer system. The Environmental Engineering Intern will conduct investigations to determine the scope of a required sewer cleaning and television inspection. Supervises contractor’s work during sewer cleaning or television inspection to ensure compliance with regulations and Contract requirements. description: At the Bronx District Attorney's Office, we believe that the future of public service is built through meaningful opportunities to learn, lead, and serve. Our Summer Legal Internship Program is designed to help students move from pipeline to purpose—transforming classroom knowledge into practical experience and inspiring the next generation of prosecutors, advocates, and public service leaders. Through mentorship, training, and hands-on learning opportunities, interns gain exposure to the realities of public service while building the professional skills, judgment, and leadership qualities necessary for a successful legal career. The Bronx District Attorney's Office is committed to "Pursuing Justice with Integrity" while enhancing public safety and strengthening community trust. Serving more than 1.4 million residents, our Office offers law students the opportunity to engage in meaningful public service while learning from experienced prosecutors and legal professionals dedicated to advancing justice in the Bronx. The nine-week program will take place during the Summer of 2027, commencing on Tuesday, June 1st, and concluding on Friday, July 30th. Interns work full-time, in person, Monday through Friday, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Interns are assigned to a specific bureau within the Office. An Assistant District Attorney directly supervises them. Whether observing courtroom proceedings, assisting attorneys with legal research and writing, participating in simulations, or engaging with leaders across the Office, interns are encouraged to move from Pipeline to Purpose—transforming their interest in the law into meaningful public service. Program Overview The Summer Legal Internship Program is a nine-week, full-time, in-person experience beginning June 1, 2027. Interns will: Observe court proceedings, hearings, and trials. Conduct legal research and drafting assignments. Assist attorneys with case preparation and litigation support. Participate in training programs, lectures, and professional development workshops. Engage in simulation exercises designed to strengthen advocacy and litigation skills. Network with attorneys, executive leadership, and criminal justice professionals. Gain insight into the responsibilities and ethical obligations of public service attorneys.
requirements: Internship Responsibilities Summer Legal Interns will gain hands-on experience within one of the nation's leading prosecutor's offices. Interns may be assigned to the Trial Division, Investigations Division, Strategic Innovations Division, Appeals Bureau, or Community Justice initiatives, and have the opportunity to work with BXDA's Digital Forensic Laboratory—the first accredited digital forensic laboratory in a prosecutor's office in New York State and the first accredited digital forensic laboratory in New York City. Eligible interns may have the opportunity to appear in court under the Student Practice Order and will assist attorneys with legal research, case preparation, witness interviews, hearings, trials, police report review, and other substantive legal assignments. Interns will also participate in a rigorous training program featuring lectures from criminal justice professionals and simulation-based practicums designed to strengthen advocacy and litigation skills. Every effort will be made to provide interns with a substantive writing assignment that may serve as a future writing sample. Who Should Apply? We seek students who are intellectually curious, committed to public service, and eager to learn in a fast-paced legal environment. Successful interns demonstrate strong analytical abilities, sound judgment, professionalism, initiative, and a willingness to contribute as members of a team. Why BXDA? At BXDA, interns are more than observers—they are valued members of our community. Our program combines substantive legal work, mentorship, professional development, and meaningful exposure to public service careers. Interns leave with a deeper understanding of the criminal justice system, stronger professional networks, and practical skills that will serve them throughout their careers. About lemon.markets
🍋
We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.
lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.
As part of the dwpbank group, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella.
Your Mission:
As a Founder’s Associate, you will work closely with the Founder and CEO and leadership team to help drive the company’s strategic priorities and operational execution.
In this role, you will take ownership of high-impact, cross-functional projects across the business. These may range from supporting strategic initiatives in commercial, product, and operations teams to improving internal processes, building organisational structures, and helping ensure alignment as the company scales.
This role is ideal for someone who is excited by our mission of enabling anyone to invest in capital markets. You will be close to many strategic initiatives and interact beyond lemon.markets towards our parent company, dwpbank. You will get the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work closely with experienced experts across functions while taking on meaningful ownership in a dynamic and ambitious environment.
This is going to be the ride of a lifetime for someone, who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and wants to gain first-hand experience in how a high-growth fintech infrastructure company is built.
You will:
Support the Founder and CEO on strategic and operational projects that drive company goals and priorities.
Own and lead projects with a deep focus on brokerage, custody and capital markets, this is where you will spend a significant part of your time and where domain knowledge is essential.
Analyse market developments, competitor dynamics, and trends across the European brokerage, wealth, and investment infrastructure landscape.
Take ownership of special projects that support the next stage of lemon.markets’ growth.
Lead and mentor the Founder’s Associate Intern team, providing structure, guidance, and prioritisation across projects while helping develop their skills and ensuring high-quality execution.
Contribute to refining and scaling internal processes, documentation, and operating structures across the company, especially in light of what becomes possible with AI.
Help develop, structure, and execute cross-functional initiatives across teams.
Act as a connector across the organisation by understanding team priorities, spotting gaps and blockers early, and helping drive effective cross-functional collaboration.
You’ll be successful in this role if you:
You have a background (bachelor and master degree) in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Computer science or a similar area.
You are an entrepreneurial problem solver.
You strive to take ownership of the tasks you get and apply your analytical skills, structured thinking, and independent working style towards solving them.
You have gained 2 years or more of hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment.
Ideally, you have worked in an early-stage startup, fintech, consulting, tech company or similar.
You bring experience from the world of brokerage, trading or custody
and/or are deeply excited to get into the engine room details of our mission to make anyone an investor.
You cope well with frequent change and ambiguity.
Changing tasks & requirements excite you. You are able to think logically, break down complex problems and prioritise between multiple tasks on your table.
You are a team player.
Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you.
You never let anything fall down your plate.
Being on top of things is what you are known for. Having no hesitation to follow up on people until the job gets done.
You are ready and willing to take ownership.
“This is not my job!” is not part of your vocabulary - you identify problems, take initiative to take them on, and challenge the status quo.
How we take care of you:
🚀 Compensation package:
We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to

lemon.markets
.
🕑 Flexible working hours:
We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.
🏢 Hybrid work setup:
You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.
📈
Grow with us:
We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.
🌱 People & culture:
You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.
💛 Perks & benefits:
We

choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.
🏝 Workation:
Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.
If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

description: The NYC Financial Information Services Agency - Office of Payroll Administration (FISA-OPA) seeks to hire an IT Intern in the Technical Services group, who will help and learn how to support maintenance and security of our corporate Windows 11 environment. This role provides a learning experience in enterprise Windows administration, focusing on patch management (Ivanti, SCCM/MECM), endpoint reporting, and technical troubleshooting. The successful candidate will assist with system audits, utilize PowerShell and Excel for data analysis, and help resolve workstation issues to ensure seamless business operations. This is an ideal entry-point for a candidate looking to gain practical experience in endpoint security, auditing, and IT support within a professional enterprise setting. Responsibilities: Under the guidance of senior IT staff, the IT Intern will participate and learn to manage Windows environment. Endpoint Management & Patching Gain hands-on experience deploying and maintaining Windows 11 updates using tools like Ivanti Security Controls and SCCM/MECM, with occasional after-hours work (weeknights/weekends) to minimize user impact. Help monitor patch deployments to ensure devices are secure. Assist in the deployment of new software, application updates, and workstation hardware refreshes. Data Analysis & Reporting Learn to run and distribute reports on software inventory, hardware health, and patch compliance. Use Microsoft Excel to organize and validate IT data, gaining experience with pivot tables, formulas, and conditional formatting. Compare data across different systems (Active Directory, SCCM, Ivanti) to ensure records are accurate. Technical Troubleshooting Develop your troubleshooting skills by resolving common Windows 11 issues, including performance lags, printer connectivity, and application errors. Learn to use professional diagnostic tools such as Event Viewer, Task Manager, and Command Prompt. Gain exposure to PowerShell by using basic scripts to automate data collection and administrative tasks. Documentation & Process Help create and update how to documentation for common technical fixes and patching procedures. Practice professional escalation by documenting your troubleshooting steps before handing off complex issues to senior engineers. Additional Information CA-06 To Apply Applicants may visit the Jobs NYC website: www.nyc.gov/jobs and apply to Job ID: 797780. While all complete applications will be given consideration, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. Employment is conditioned upon continuance as a student in a college or graduate school with a specific course of study in information technology, computer science, management information systems, data processing, or closely related field, including or supplemented by 9 semester credits in an acceptable course of study. Appointments to this Assignment Level will be made by the Technology Steering Committee through the Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications. description:
Your Role
As Senior Product Manager – Client Experience & Engagement (f/m/d) you own everything that happens after a client's first investment. You shape the digital home of our clients across web and native app: portfolio reporting, performance insights, documents, settings and self-services, and you turn it into an experience worthy of a premium wealth manager. Our clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You design how these investments are experienced, understood and told as a story in the product. Your mandate is twofold: make the day-to-day experience exceptional, and grow the relationship through digital up- and cross-sell of additional portfolios, products and account types. LIQID is hybrid by design, so you build a digital experience in which the personal Relationship Manager is natively woven in rather than bolted on. Clients should never feel a seam between their app and their advisor.
What you'll do
•
End-to-End Client Experience Ownership:
Own the active client journey from first investment onward across web and native app. You set the vision for portfolio reporting, portfolio KPIs and performance communication, document management, account settings and self-services, and you raise the quality bar until the digital experience matches the standard of our investment products. That includes the storytelling layer for private markets: making capital calls, distributions, J-curves and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, tangible and understandable for clients. You define and evolve the North Star and KPI tree for active clients, building on our existing engagement framework (top-ups, additional portfolio and account openings, share of wallet, dashboard engagement, self-service completion) and developing it further where you see sharper signals.
•
Digital Up- & Cross-Sell:
Design and scale the journeys that deepen client relationships: time to first top-up, second portfolio and second product adoption, additional account types (joint, kids), and share-of-wallet growth. You identify natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove your impact with honest, causal measurement rather than correlation stories. You build repeatable growth systems for the existing client base instead of one-off campaigns.
•
Hybrid Experience & RM Integration:
Make the Relationship Manager a first-class citizen of the digital product. You design how human advice surfaces inside the app: contextual RM touchpoints, seamless handovers between self-service and personal consultation, and self-service flows for major actions (top-ups, strategy changes, tax documents) that reduce friction without reducing trust. You measure and improve the interplay between RM engagement and client outcomes, from retention to share of wallet.
•
Discovery, Data & Experimentation:
Run continuous discovery with clients and Relationship Managers to understand what HNW clients actually need from their wealth dashboard. You define tracking schemas and metric contracts for the active client domain, run experiments and cohort analyses across engagement, retention and multi-product adoption, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles. You act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional squad of Engineering and Design, and prioritize with a transparent impact and effort logic that also means saying no.
What you bring
•
Background:
7+ years of experience in Product Management for digital consumer products, ideally in FinTech, WealthTech, banking or another trust-driven domain. Experience with engagement, retention or CRM-driven product work is a strong plus, as is exposure to native app development.
•
Analytical & Technical Fluency:
Hands-on experience with product analytics, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, and attribute impact credibly. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype and compress your own cycles.
•
Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy:
Genuine interest in investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction) and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment. You understand that our clients entrust us with significant wealth and that every pixel of the experience either builds or erodes that trust.
•
Communication & Language:
Fluent in English (German a plus!), able to align Product, Design, Engineering, CRM and Relationship Management around one coherent client experience, and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership.
•
Drive & Motivation:
Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid wealth experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.
Don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to receiving your application.
What we offer
Diversity:
Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.
Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.
Appreciation:
You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.
Development:
We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.
Smart Money:
As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.
Well-being:
Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.
What happens next
An excellent candidate experience and a high level of transparency are our top priorities throughout the interview process. The different stages of the application process are designed to help us understand what a potential collaboration could look like.
Short introductory call with our Recruiting team: A relaxed first get-to-know-each-other conversation.
Video interview with the Hiring Manager: We discuss whether your experience and expectations for the role align with our requirements.
Case study: We would like to see how you approach complex challenges and demonstrate your problem-solving skills in a realistic work scenario.
In-person meeting: You meet the team and gain practical insights into the day-to-day work.
About us
We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.
We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €3.8 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including
LGT
,
Toscafund
,
HQ Trust
, and
Project A
.
LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applications are considered without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnic or national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal opportunity laws.

description:
WePush is a creator marketplace connecting brands with creators at scale. We’re looking for an experienced Fullstack Platform Engineer who enjoys architecture, infrastructure, and running real systems in production end-to-end.

This is a hands-on startup role, not a narrow DevOps position. You’ll build backend features, improve our infrastructure, and own what you ship from design to production.

Tasks

What you’ll do

Build backend services and APIs for campaigns, creator matching, marketplace operations, and payments.

Design clear domain models, database schemas, and service boundaries.

Build reliable background jobs that handle concurrency, retries, and failures correctly.

Contribute to our Web, Android, and iOS frontend when features require end-to-end ownership.

Improve deployments, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, backups, and recovery.

Debug issues across application code, databases, infrastructure, and third-party APIs.

Make pragmatic architectural decisions while continuing to ship quickly.

Use AI coding agents as a core part of your daily development workflow.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

Strong backend engineering experience in production environments.

Excellent knowledge of SQL, relational databases, transactions, locking, and data modelling.

Experience with Docker, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD.

A good understanding of queues, scheduled jobs, APIs, networking, security, and observability.

Confidence reasoning about concurrency, idempotency, partial failures, and recovery.

Strong debugging skills across the full system.

Startup experience or a strong bias toward ownership and execution.

Good product judgment and an instinct for avoiding unnecessary complexity.

Experience using AI coding agents to plan, implement, test, review, and document software.

The ability to critically review, iterate on, and improve AI-generated code until it is high-quality and production-ready.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Docker, Linux, and Hack. Experience with every technology is not required, we care more about strong fundamentals and the ability to learn.

AI-native engineering:

Using AI agents is a requirement for this role, not an optional productivity tool.

We expect you to use them throughout the development process: exploring unfamiliar code, planning changes, implementing features, writing tests, investigating failures, reviewing work, and maintaining documentation.

This does not mean accepting generated code without understanding it. You remain responsible for architecture, security, correctness, and production outcomes. We are looking for someone who knows how to give agents useful context, break work into verifiable steps, review their output critically, and use them to increase both speed and quality.

You’ll probably enjoy this role if:

You have worked in an early stage startup/scale-up

You like owning systems after they go live.

You naturally ask what happens when a process crashes halfway through.

You can move between backend code, SQL, infrastructure, and debugging.

You prefer simple, dependable systems over fashionable architecture.

You are excited about developing with AI agents and actively improving how you use them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of AI, creator technology, and consumer products.

WePush is backed by experienced operators from companies including Spotify, Google and many more. We’re entering our next phase of growth with the ambition, speed, and ownership of a startup, but with a proven product and strong market traction.

As an AI Product Engineer, you won’t be sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work closely with the founders and product team to turn new AI capabilities into products used by brands and creators at scale.

What we offer:

Competitive salary and meaningful equity package

High ownership from day one with the freedom to ship, experiment, and influence product direction

Direct access to founders and leadership with fast decisions and minimal bureaucracy

A team of builders: Ambitious, pragmatic, and obsessed with moving fast

An in-person culture in our Berlin office, with flexibility for home office days

Public transport pass, gym membership, recurring team lunches, and other perks

A front-row seat to building a category-defining technology company

Regardless of who you are, where you come from, how you look, or what music is playing in your headphones, you are welcome.

If you are a builder and move fast, this role is for you.

description: The Office of General Counsel (OGC) provides legal support for the agency and its many public health functions serving more than 8 million New Yorkers. The Enforcement Unit is comprised of a subset of specialized attorneys within OGC who play a leading role in advancing the NYC Health Department's major public health enforcement initiatives. OGC is seeking an attorney to oversee the Enforcement Unit and handle administrative litigation that ensures citywide compliance with public health laws and regulations. The Enforcement Unit addresses some of the most urgent public health enforcement challenges facing New York City, including prosecuting childcare providers whose practices endanger children, enforcing food safety requirements at restaurants, issuing disease surveillance orders in connection with outbreaks, and ensuring that dog owners comply with recommended control measures following dangerous dog incidents. For example, enforcement Unit attorneys file administrative proceedings against holders of Department-issued licenses and permits. They also advise Department programs on compliance and enforcement procedures and participate in drafting and reviewing legislation that supports the Unit's work. The Enforcement Unit regularly coordinates with other city and state agencies. The attorney may also assist in liaising with these agencies and with the New York City Law Department on civil litigation matters. DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO: The attorney would serve as the Director of the Enforcement Unit, reporting to the First Deputy General Counsel. Under general direction from the General Counsel and First Deputy General Counsel, the Director of the Enforcement Unit will oversee the Enforcement Unit and will: • Represent the agency at hearings, conferences and trials before the Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings (OATH). This includes performing all areas of case management including but not limited to: 1) designing a case strategy; 2) preparing and serving petitions; 3) negotiating settlements; 4) preparing witness; and, 5) assembling evidence. • Research and prepare briefs, appeals, orders, motions, legal opinions, memoranda and other legal papers related to enforcement cases. • Receive and assess complaints with Department programs to determine if enforcement action is needed. • Work with various Department programs to promote more effective enforcement and compliance and identify problem areas appropriate for enhanced enforcement or special initiatives. • Become well-versed in Department program policies and regulations to provide input to the programs about processes that would strengthen enforcement cases. • Liaise with Law Department, state and city agencies. • Travel to courts, when needed in-person within New York City. • Maintain sensitive and confidential information. • Manage and distribute information accurately and appropriately. • Monitor the workflow, ensuring compliance with deadlines, and preparing reports and summaries. • Establish positive working relationships with co-workers and programs. • Possess excellent research and writing skills • Attend to other ad hoc projects and tasks, as needed or assigned to ensure the continuity of operations within OGC. PREFERRED SKILLS: • Strong written and oral advocacy skills with attention to detail. • Knowledge of or interest in administrative or regulatory law. • Ability to negotiate settlements with opposing counsel. • Prior experience managing and training attorneys on administrative/OATH trials and hearings. • Strong interpersonal, creative problem-solving, and organizational skills. • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple cases and projects in a timely manner. • Ability to use online legal research platforms such as Westlaw, CLEAR, and Lexis Nexis. • Experience training other attorneys is a plus. • Current working knowledge of Health Department procedures, policies and practices is a plus. • Current knowledge or interest in public health matters is a plus. Why you should work for us: - Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/) - Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as: o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment. o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund. o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement. o a tax-deferred savings program and o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers. - Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home. - Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work. Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise. Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers! The NYC Health Department is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation to all individuals. description:
Your mission
We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Owner to take ownership of our C++ SDK, which forms the core of our software platform and serves as the foundation for the majority of our engineering work, products, and customer projects.
You will shape the product direction, roadmap, priorities, and release process while working closely with software engineers, our Lead Architect, product teams, and business stakeholders.
The role is designed to grow into functional and people leadership responsibility for engineers working on the C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite.
Your responsibilities
Own and continuously develop product vision, roadmap, backlog, and prioritization for our C++ SDK & ImFusion Suite
Align C++ SDK and ImFusion Suite roadmap with our wider company and platform strategy
Bring together requirements from customers, internal users, product teams, engineering, and management and translate them into clear priorities.
Coordinate development activities and releases across teams and components, ensuring that individual efforts contribute to a coherent product.
Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.
Balance short-term delivery needs with technical quality and the long-term development of the product.
Drive resource planning, support team growth, and gradually take on functional and people leadership.
Who you are
You are a systems thinker who can understand a complex technical ecosystem, connect the individual pieces, and maintain sight of the bigger picture.
You combine genuine technical curiosity with a strong product mindset and a desire to create impact beyond implementation.
You bring clarity and structure to ambiguous situations without oversimplifying technical complexity.
You listen to different perspectives but are comfortable challenging assumptions, setting boundaries, and saying no when necessary—regardless of seniority or role.
You communicate confidently with engineers, scientists, product teams, customers, and management and build trust across these groups.
You take ownership, follow through, and proactively address risks and obstacles.
You lead through trust, constructive feedback, sound judgement, and a genuine interest in helping others grow.
Your profile
Several years of experience as a software engineer, giving you a solid understanding of programming and software development.
Subsequent experience owning or coordinating a technically complex software product, platform, or large-scale engineering initiative.
Experience developing roadmaps, managing requirements, setting priorities, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience coordinating, mentoring, or enabling software engineers; previous formal leadership experience is a plus.
A strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, testing, technical debt, maintainability, versioning, and backwards compatibility.
Experience with capacity and resource planning, including translating roadmap needs into staffing or hiring requirements.
Hands-on experience adapting SDK requirements, architecture, and product roadmaps to advances in AI.
Nice to have
Experience with C++ development or ownership of a C++-based product or platform.
Experience with developer-facing products or SDKs.
A background in medical imaging, computer vision, or another technically complex software domain.
Ideally, you are based in Munich or the surrounding area and enjoy working regularly from our Munich office, allowing you to connect with key stakeholders in person.
Why us?
Shape foundational technologies used across our products and customer projects.
Work closely with experienced engineers, architects, and product teams.
Take on significant ownership and grow into functional and people leadership.
Work on challenging software at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, and AI.
Benefit from flexible working arrangements and a collaborative environment.
The stated salary range includes a discretionary, performance-based bonus.
